description: CONFIRMED mapped defect #1. Visits setup requests /api/patients?page=1&limit=1 and /api/users?role=DOCTOR&limit=1. "Select Doctor" lists only "Dr. Praneeta Jain" (newest doctor) - for Dr. Praneeta it happens to be right, but signed in as Dr. Shravya she cannot select herself.
expected: All active doctors listed, defaulting to the signed-in doctor.
actual: One doctor; Dr. Shravya cannot start a visit under her own name from setup.
suggested_fix: Fetch all doctors (or search), default to current user when DOCTOR.

description: Deep link /dashboard/visits?patientId=<Rohit>&autoStart=true (the Patients-row "Start Visit" path) opened by Dr. Shravya shows "Doctor: Dr. Praneeta Jain" and the first save POSTed doctorId=Praneeta; visit cmw6emf3f00917dc1n2bk0h9e is now recorded under Dr. Praneeta. (Existing visits opened by visitId also PATCH doctorId=Praneeta; the backend ignored it there.)
expected: Visits started by a doctor are attributed to that doctor.
actual: Silent misattribution of clinical documentation to another doctor.
suggested_fix: Default doctorId to the authenticated DOCTOR (or the appointment doctor); never fall back to the first fetched doctor; reject mismatches server-side.

description: After picking "Sanjay Mehta" the Ready-to-start line directly under the field reads "Patient: Unknown • Doctor: Dr. Praneeta Jain"; the form sub-heading repeats "Patient: Unknown".
suggested_fix: Keep the selected patient object from the search result instead of looking it up in the limit=1 list.

description: CONFIRMED "No photos" variation of mapped defect #2: on the walk-in with vitals, labs (Save Labs with nothing selected) and a created prescription, progress caps at 60% - Complete Visit stays disabled. A walk-in without photos can never be completed.
suggested_fix: Drop photos/labs from the completion gate or make sections N/A-able.

description: Create Prescription with a medicine whose Duration is blank returns 400 and toasts the raw DTO message "items.0.duration must not be less than 1 (Reference: …)"; the row is not highlighted.
expected: Inline "Enter a duration for Adapalene" on the row before submit.
actual: Technical message with array index and reference id.
suggested_fix: Validate rows client-side and map server field errors to row/field.

description: The form shows "Unsaved changes" immediately after Start Visit Documentation, before any edit.
expected: No dirty indicator until the user edits.
suggested_fix: Initialise the dirty baseline after the form hydrates.

description: The setup page leads with a "Your Role & Permissions" card and ends with an "Available Features" marketing card ("Full SOAP notes", "Complete care plans"); the role "Doctor" is stated four times. On mobile the role badge breaks mid-word ("Doct/or") and the primary Start New Visit card is pushed below the fold.
expected: Start New Visit is the first thing on the page.
actual: Two non-actionable cards around the only task.
suggested_fix: Remove or collapse the role/features cards.
